item.title: Lay of the land: terrestrial conservation efforts cover a wider area than thought
item.content:encoded:
Nature, Published online: 14 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03081-4

Governments around the world have pledged to conserve 30% of the terrestrial realm by 2030, but official data suggest that the target is barely halfway to being met. A combined global and national-level data set now shows that up to 27% of land area is conserved, but gaps in ecological representation remain.

item.content:encoded:
Nature, Published online: 14 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03085-0

Alveolar type 2 (AT2) cells are the stem cells of the lung’s air sacs and are responsible for maintaining alveolar structure and gas exchange. A study that tracked AT2 cells shows that, after injury to the airway, they can also migrate between lung compartments and become bronchiolar cells to help repair damaged airways.
